attributes.action: Make those convicted for domestic abuse ineligible for early release
attributes.additional_details: I am a survivor of horrific domestic abuse. I am worried that domestic abusers may end up only serving a fraction of their sentences. Victims should be allowed the time to heal before their abuser is released.
attributes.background: I want the Government to change the law so that people convicted of serious domestic abuse offences must serve their full prison sentence instead of being released early.
